svg.title: Fig. 1, Claims platform
svg.desc: Figure 1, Claims platform, medical billing company, exploded view. 1, Interface: Next.js and React. Imports are retryable and sit behind a preview-and-confirm step. 2, API: NestJS, typed end to end with OpenAPI and Zod. 3, Claims engine: Re-validates payer, authorization, provider and rate data at generation time and groups claims deterministically. 4, Data: PostgreSQL through Drizzle. Unsafe, malformed or wrong-account files are rejected before they land. Claim path: Billing files, then Per-client mapping, then Payer-rule validation, then X12 837P file, then Payer, then 999 acknowledgment. Replaced a spreadsheet billing workflow. Delivered under a fixed-price contract. Test files: 773 (unit, integration and end-to-end). Commits: 36 (since October 2026). TypeScript files: 1,169 (source files). Computed 2026-10-10 at commit 1e9ea66.
